steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Anna, do you know what time it is?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Anna!

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Sonya, you can see I've been assembling my outfit. The clock's behind you. You have the power to look for yourself.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: It's already twenty 'til!

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Your warning is appreciated.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Yeah, I AM warning you!

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: I did tell you how strenuous it is to coordinate an outfit, and that it could take a very long time. If you're hungry, you can go to the canteen for lunch, and I'll head there myself once I'm done.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Do you really need to do all this just for some food festival booth?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Sure, you're manning it, so you wanna dress up a little. But do you have to take this long? It's already been half an hour.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Is half an hour so long?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: It's not short.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: It's worth taking the time to ensure we match well with the theme of our booth.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: And that theme is 'Ursus Desserts'. That's it.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Like, we're Ursus from Ursus, even if we're wearing plain old Rhodes Island uniforms, we're gonna fit the theme. How are you still working on this?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: If you're going to be so impatient, you don't have to be here.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Hmph. Fine. I'll go eat.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: I know you're reading your book there because you want to keep me company. You don't want to leave me alone

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: But there's no need to force yourself, Sonya.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Want me to bring you something to eat?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: No thank you. I'll go to the canteen myself in a moment.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: I'm bac—

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Anna... why are you still screwing around with your clothes?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: I'm almost finished. I only need about ten more minutes, barring any calamities. All that's left is a hairband to settle on.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Slow down there, speedy. Don't give me whiplash.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Sonya.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: You done?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: What do you think of this hairband? It goes well with the ensemble, but isn't it too plain?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Can you just tell me what you want already?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: I think we can do something to spruce it up. What if we take some lace from the old clothes in that box there and sew it on?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Don't look at me. I don't know the first thing about sewing.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Then it's up to me.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: You think I don't know you've never held a needle in your life?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Ahem.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: While I've never actually put it into practice, I have read a few books on the subject. I have an understanding of the basic concepts. And we have plenty of lace, anyway, we can do a test run on a towel first.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: And how long is that gonna take?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Maybe... one hour?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Anna!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Did you forget all the baking supplies we've gotta haul this afternoon?!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Yeah, me and Rosalind will bring the muscle, but you've gotta be there to tell us how much of what we're moving to where!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: This is a FOOD festival. Isn't the food the important part? Focus on the food first, and then if you've got time left over, screw around with your clothes and whatever. Doesn't that make sense?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: You can take this if you're worried that you won't know what to move where.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: What's this paper?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Recipes. I stayed up all night preparing them. They have the desserts we'll be making and the ingredients needed to make them. Good luck.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: And while you're correct that our theming and decor is less important than the food, that doesn't mean appearances are entirely unimportant.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Suppose Natalya bakes some cookies that taste fine, but they come in random, unattractive shapes. Would you prefer to eat those, or Lada's?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: *Sigh*...

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Whatever, there's no getting through to you.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: I give up. You win. I'm gonna go find Rosalind.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Good luck. I'll be there to help you shortly.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Phew... we had a bit of a scare there, but I've got the lace nicely sewn onto the headband.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: (Forgive me, Lada, for breaking into your secret snack stash... I'll pay you back double tomorrow.)

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: It's two o'clock already...

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: I'd better go check on Sonya and Rosalind.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Natalya?

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Good afternoon, Anna—I see you're in a hurry. May I ask to where?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Good afternoon, have you seen Rosalind?

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Rosalind?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Yes, we were supposed to go with Sonya to move the flour and such this afternoon. But neither of us have been able to find her.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: I do believe she's in the training room.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: You saw her?

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: I can't say I laid my own eyes on her, but I did see two bottles of non-honeyed honey-flavored beverage at the door to the training room. To my knowledge, only Rosalind and Beehunter drink those.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Thank you very much, Natalya. You have a class in the afternoon, don't you?

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: I still have time, no need to rush.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Ah, but there is the matter of the application for the booth. You've asked that none of the surrounding booths serve beverages, and that yours should be close to the entrance, yes?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: That's correct. I would also like for the booth to be as large as possible, but I understand that's beyond our control.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: If there are too many participants, there simply won't be room for a large booth.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Indeed. Now then, I'll be sure to discuss the booth situation with Closure after my class.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Thank you very much.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Think nothing of it.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Although, I do believe this is the first time I've ever seen you so passionate about something besides books, Anna.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Is that a compliment?

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: I would like to think so.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Then I'll thank you once more.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Good luck, Anna.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: And the same to you, Natalya.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: —Of course, to drag Rosalind out of the training room, you're going to need it.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Your prospects there are far more pessimistic, I believe.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Istina! What goes in the oven next?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Cheese piroshki. They're already on the baking sheet, waiting for the last custard tart to come out.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Thanks for your help, Istina!

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Don't mention it.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: I'm so glad you're here!

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: You've been helping set up the booth all day, and even went to fetch Leto for us, and got us fresh berries from the greenhouse with juuust the right acidity...

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: I thought you'd be really tired by now.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Well, I can't say it's been easy.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: So I think you'd better go back to your room and read for a bit! I can handle all this by myself!

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Of course, I'm sure you can do it.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: But two heads are certainly more efficient than a single Gummy.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: You're really awesome, Istina.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Oh?

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: I used to think just baking some tasty treats for everybody to enjoy at the festival would be enough.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: But you taught me good food alone doesn't cut it. To really make the festival perfect, you've gotta work out your theming, get a design, make everything match...

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: It's really awesome that you even think of this stuff, but you don't stop at the thinking, you actually come out and help us do everything. You find the time to lend Zima and little old Gummy a hand...

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: I never knew how awesome you were, Istina!

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: You're making me blush, Lada—

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Sorry, you're more comfortable with operator codenames now, yes?

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Don't worry about it. Istina can call Gummy any name she wants!

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Thank you, Gummy.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: (To have Lada showering me with compliments like that... I really am blushing.)

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: (Especially considering how I just stole from her snack stash...)

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Oh, Gummy, there's something I have to tell you.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: What is it, Istina?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: While I was back at the room working on my outfit, I didn't have time to go to the canteen. I'm afraid I ate all the snacks you had hidden in the living room cabinet.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Oh? I don't remember putting any snacks there.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: But I found a package of cookies, they were pumpkin-flavored. I remember you were into pumpkin for a while.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Pumpkin, huh...? Let me think...

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Istina...

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Oh no... Gummy... why did your face turn so dour...?

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Did those cookies taste really extra bitter and bad?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: I... paired them with some coffee.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: I burned those pumpkin cookies when I was baking in the canteen this morning.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: But it hurt my heart to think of throwing them away, so I put them in the bottom of the cabinet. I figured I could find some use for them.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: I mean, eating them won't do anything to you, but...

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: You've said enough, Gummy, I get it.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Just go home and get some rest! Leave it all to Gummy here. When everything's baked up, I'll call everyone to taste test!

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: With nothing to it but the traditional Ursus elements... hm... it feels a little shallow...

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: What if we added a little something else? Something like... a puzzle game?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: With just an outfit, a set of clothes, is there really a way to add deductive reasoning? Probably not.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: But if we put it into the desserts—No, that won't work. It's not like we can make a puzzle out of them.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: What about using the deductive elements as a sort of decoration?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Still a little off...

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: I've got it!
Istina pulls a stack of books from the cabinet.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: These books just might give us what we need.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: 'The Death of Ilyich, the Suspect', we can't well use this one.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Hm... let me think... with these books—

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: The idea is coming together, this should be possible.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Then we put the rest of them as padding underneath.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Need a few more clues... a chessboard, maybe? Let me see...

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Welcome back, Sonya.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: What are you doing back here?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: I had another idea. I need to revise the layout of our festival booth.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: The layout—Oh...

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: (Whispers) I'm getting a headache.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: I heard that.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Huh? 'The Death of Ilyich, the Suspect'? I borrowed this book.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: I recommended it to you.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: I forgot.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: So, do you remember the plot of the book?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Nope.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: What about the name of the killer?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Not coming to me.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: So what exactly did you read?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: I never remember anything after I finish a novel.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Like, what's the point of remembering the plot of a book? Not like I'm gonna be a writer.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Forget it. This is my fault. I still have unrealistic expectations of you.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: (Whistles)

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Now then, there will be a puzzle in our booth, and it derives from these books.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: 'Ten Little Durins', 'The Feranmut Four', 'Murder in Mossmead'... I feel like I've read these, but I also feel like I haven't.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: You've been through all of them, and somehow didn't retain a thing.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: I thought you'd be able to solve this puzzle, but now I find you can't.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: As if I even wanted to.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Not worth your time?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: I just couldn't care less. I'm dead tired from hauling that crap all afternoon. The last thing I need is another pain in the ass.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: How about this? If you solve the puzzle on the day of the festival, I'll do your homework for you exactly once.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: You've been skipping Hypatia's class lately, haven't you?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Deal!

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: On the other hand, if you can't solve it...

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: We'll need a punishment. One I've not yet thought of.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Hmph. Punishment, huh? As if that scares me.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: I'll be in my room.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: You'll what?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: What else am I gonna do? I told you, I'm dead tired. I'm going to bed.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: I thought you'd at least take a book back to review. You have to prepare for the puzzle.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: I know I'll be able to solve it when the time comes. Sleep is more important for now.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Well, good luck, Sonya.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Thanks—
Zima takes a few steps toward her room before turning back to Istina.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Actually, Anna, there's something I've been meaning to ask you since this morning.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Go ahead.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: I've never seen you so passionate about something like this. You're even more into it than Lada is. You're totally committed to getting it perfect.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: But why?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Any guesses?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Hm... to make Lada happy?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Making Lada happy is a delightful thing, but that's not the reason.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: To sell lots of sweets?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: You've forgotten, Sonya, everything at the festival is free.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: So what's the reason?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: I just want to know what it feels like to go all in, for once.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: All in?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Have you lost your marbles? You're suddenly missing the old days?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: This is different, Sonya. Listen to me.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Back in those days...

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Back in those days, we went all in and put it all on the line because if we slipped up even for a second, we were dead.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: But this is different.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Now we're going all in on a happy little thing. How long has it been since we've busied ourselves with a happy little thing?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Think about it. The core of a food festival is a pleasant holiday atmosphere and the joy of eating. It doesn't get much more fun and relaxed than that.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: What we did before, we did out of necessity. But now, laying it all on the line for a delightful little festival... I've never tried anything like that. And I want to.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: When the day of the festival comes, it'll probably be a lot of fun.
Zima shrugs.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: I think you're having fun already.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Am I?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Yeah.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Welp, I may not get what's so much fun for you...

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: But I hope it makes you happy.

steps.name: Cardigan
steps.text: Wowww! Soo many booths, and with so much food! I'm worried I can't eat it all...

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: Calm down, Cardigan, the festival runs all day.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Why are you following me at a time like this?!

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: It is precisely at a time like this that our little Lava needs to watch what she eats—

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: What a uniquely sweet smell—

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: Tell me about this thing. It's a custard tart, right?

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: And this one's a berry cake! I'd love to know the exact ratios at play in the recipe!

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: It would be my pleasure...

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Treeaaaaats! I smell treeaaats!

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Woooow! So many people! And so much food!

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Little Cub made those snacks! They smell sooooo goooood!

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Kay, slow down, no running!

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: How was the berry cake over there? Gummy only just brought out a tray and before I knew it, they'd all been snatched up.

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: Unusually delicious.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: What do you think, Ifrit?

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: ...not spicy enough...

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: But the one with the light blue hair, she's dressed very pretty.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Watch this, Popukar—

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: You threw the pastry up in the air, then caught it in your mouth on the way down—awesome!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: You wanna try? I can teach you—

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Gah!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: I don't want Popukar learning any stupid and dangerous tricks from you!

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: I've known for a while that Maggy has a very unique palate, but I never knew it went this far...

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Oh, is that some kind of puzzle thing over there?

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: I've gotta check that out.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: What do you think of the puzzle Istina and the girls designed, Doctor?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Is something wrong, Doctor? Why are you so quiet?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Show a little restraint, Doctor, you've already eaten so much.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: The food festival's over...

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: I asked Midnight to wake me up, but the clown slipped out without a word.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Guess I shouldn't have stayed up all night reading comics.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: What are those girls doing over there instead of packing up their booth?

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: I can't make out what they're saying—Huh? A shaved ice stand behind the stairs? I didn't even know it was there.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Yep, got plenty of cans left! Here you go!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: (Takes a deep breath)

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Graaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaagh!

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Is that the legendary Ursus's Roar?

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: It's awe-inspiring.

a.text: Our booth was a big hit at the food festival.
We had a steady stream of operators coming to try things. Some came to eat, some came to try the puzzle, and some came just to look at my outfit...
Lada had to keep the ovens hot, and we went through all our spare supplies.
Sonya and Rosalind had to keep running back and forth between our booth and the kitchen.
Natalya explained all our treats to the customers. She talked her throat sore.
I had the most relaxed job, spending the day watching over the puzzle.

steps.text: Istina speaks directly into the 'recording device for self-diagnosis and treatment of trauma using exposure therapy'.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: I might have had a feeling about it, but I was surprised Sonya failed to solve the puzzle. The solution was so obvious.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: It was Rosalind's idea, but everyone agreed on the punishment. That Sonya would have to eat an entire bowl of Magallan's signature canned shaved ice.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Magallan's other flavors are plenty delicious.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: But her signature canned shaved ice...

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: How should I put this...? The look on Sonya's face as she brought the ice to her mouth...

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Pfft... I can't even describe it.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: What a wonderful day.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Standing in the crowd, looking at all the smiling faces around, listening to the delightful conversations that had nothing to do with me...

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: While I normally wouldn't look to avoid such things, I also wouldn't be able to enjoy them.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: But after throwing myself into this festival, all the noise and excitement started to mean something, it even became a reward for all my efforts.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Looking back, all that exhausting preparation was no trouble at all.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Really, going all out on a happy little thing was a ton of fun.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: In the old days, several of the middle schools in Chernobog would hold events like this.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: At the time, I found them pointless in comparison to reading a good book.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: So I was clever, avoided all the prep work, then spent the day of the event at home reading.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: It wasn't a big deal, honestly.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Something so typical. What's the point?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Don't these kinds of things happen every year?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Even after graduation, we could still attend as alumni, or the general public... why work hard for something like that?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: I never imagined. I could never have imagined.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: But it's true... there will never be another one.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Never, ever again.
Istina shakes her head vigorously.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: So I spent a hundred and twenty percent of my energy on this food festival. Was that a sort of... memorialization?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: And the facts show that my efforts were worth it.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: I've never experienced an event with so many people that was so enjoyable.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: If there's another such festival...

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: I dare not hope it could be as happy as this one.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: But I certainly want to try.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Now, that's enough for today—

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Anna, I'm home—

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Welcome back, Sonya.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Wasn't today fun?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Of course!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: But if we're talking about fun, I just found out there's still some food left, so I had the whole U.S.S.G. share it. And we've got a bit for you.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Didn't I see Natalya drink all the borscht? What could be left?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: What else? Magallan's cans!

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: I'm going to bed. Good night, Sonya. Sweet dreams—

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: You're not going anywhere. You're the only one who hasn't had any—
